items.docs: The Grafana service accounts search API endpoint allows administrators to retrieve a paginated list of service accounts within an organization. This GET operation on the /serviceaccounts/search path enables filtering and searching through service accounts, returning results in a structured, paginated format that can be navigated through multiple pages.
